player_prompt.intro:
I bɛ fɛnɛ Blackjack kɔnɔ dealer.
Anw ka kɛ i ye fɛnɛ 21 kɔnɔ, walasa i ma kɛ.
Anw tɛ, ka '[Hit]' ni fɛnɛ kɛ, ni '[Stand]' ni sɔrɔ.
J/Q/K = 10 lamɛnɛ; A = 11 ni 1, ɛlɛ bɛ sɔrɔ.
